The paper describes 46 K. pneumoniae WGS isolates selected from 233 Klebsiella spp. carbapenemase producers recovered by carbapenem-selective plating (MacConkey + 1 mg/L meropenem) from migratory birds and environment at Qinghai Lake, China, August 2016. AMR selection gate was phenotypic (growth on carbapenem-selective media), hence amr_method = ast_result. Cohort_age is not_gradeable because hosts are wild migratory birds, not humans. Isolation source is predominantly bird faeces (406/420 total samples; 'mainly obtained from stools'), supports applies_whole_project = true. The novel lineage ST1697 (a putative K. quasipneumoniae subsp. similipneumoniae / K. pneumoniae hybrid) carrying NDM-5 is the main finding.
